## Purpose
Base classes for the workflow-planning layers that pass straight through once `ctx.error` is set, so a failed upstream decision is not hidden behind an empty plan.

## Responsibilities
- `workflow_ready(ctx)` requires `ctx.error is None` and a `workflow_spec`.
- `WorkflowDecisionLayer(DecisionLayer)` makes one LLM decision.
- `WorkflowStepLayer(Layer)` does deterministic work.
- Both have `should_run = enabled and workflow_ready`.

## Key elements
`workflow_ready`, `WorkflowDecisionLayer`, `WorkflowStepLayer`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Subclassed by every workflow layer.
- `workflow_ready` is also used by `KnowledgeContextLayer` and `AgentArchetypeLayer`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
The pipeline still walks to the end after an error, because the adapter needs the events. Each remaining layer just passes through.
